title: Orizn Visa Checker
shortdesc: Check visa requirements between any two countries — 49,750 pairs in 15 languages
desc:
Orizn Visa API provides instant access to visa requirements for 49,750 passport-destination pairs (199 passports x 250 destinations) in 15 languages, with official source URLs.

Endpoints:
- quickVisaCheck: Quick yes/no check (no API key needed)
- getFullVisaDetails: Full details with documents, process, tips (API key required)
- getCoverageStats: Coverage statistics (no API key needed)

Authentication: Custom header x-api-key
Get your key at https://visa.orizn.app
author: Orizn
